name: Tunnelling
body:
School transmutation [earth]; Level druid 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect A 5-ft.-by-5-ft. opening, 1 ft./level deep
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as passwall, creating an opening through earth, brick, wood, plaster, or stone barriers, but its effect is instantaneous.

Tunneling also can dig through barriers made of ice or snow, but it cannot penetrate metal. If the barrier is thicker than the spell’s area, it creates a partial tunnel. Repeated castings of the spell can continue to dig out a larger tunnel.
